cards.title: Consent-gated Meta Ads page view and contact triggers
cards.claim: For Meta Ads tracking, page view and contact form submit tags should fire only when consent is granted, using a trigger based on consent mode and the cookie consent update data layer event.
cards.action: Change the client-side Meta Ads page view trigger from initialization all pages to the cookie consent update day layer event, and configure server-side Meta tags with a trigger that fires on every page or event only if the consent mode variable indicates consent is granted.
applies_when: Meta Ads tags are implemented in a client-side and/or server-side container
You need to avoid sending information to Facebook without consent
do_not_use_when: The site does not require consent before firing Meta tags
unknowns: Exact consent mode variable setup is not shown in this passage
How to create the cookie consent update data layer event is not shown
The contact form submit trigger must exactly match the incoming event name, but the full event name is not shown in this excerpt
evidence_quotes: I changed the trigger from initialization all pages to the cookie consent update day layer event and this ensures that we're tracking on the first page load
I'm going to build a trigger that makes this event fire on every page as long as there is consent
it's really important that you don't send information to Facebook if there is no consent given

cards.title: Debug-mode-gated Meta test ID lookup variable
cards.claim: A lookup table variable keyed on the built-in debug mode can supply the Meta test event code only when debug mode is true and leave it empty for regular visitors, reducing the risk of publishing a test ID to production.
cards.action: Create a lookup table variable for the Meta test ID, set its input variable to built-in debug mode, set the default output to empty, and output the test event code only when debug mode is true; reference this variable in the test ID field of Meta Conversions API tags.
applies_when: Testing Meta Conversions API events in GTM server-side
Test event codes are needed for validation
do_not_use_when: Debug mode is not available or not used
You do not use test event codes
The test ID cannot be manually updated when it changes
unknowns: The exact lookup table template name is not specified
The exact path for the built-in debug mode variable is not shown
Test IDs can change and may require manual updates
evidence_quotes: I'm going to make a variable I'm going to call this The Meta at test ID and I'm not going to make this a constant like I did with the other variables but I'm going to make this a lookup table
as an input variable I'm going to choose and we need to look for it under built-in variables I'm going to choose the debug mode

as a default value the default value is empty so by default there is no test ID so I can hit publish and there is no test ID but in one case there is a test ID and I'm going to paste it under output and that's when debug mode is set to true
then I'm going to use a test ID but in all other cases so when a regular visitor visits my site I'm going to leave the value empty
this is a great way you do not have to yourself to remove the value you're a lot less likely to mess up your tracking setup

by the way if you set the test ID today and you want to test tomorrow chances are that the test ID has changed so sometimes you need to go back into the variable and just manually change this value to something else if the test ID has changed

cards.title: Deduplicate browser and server Meta events with an event ID
cards.claim: When the same Meta event is sent from both the browser pixel and the server-side Conversions API, an event ID is needed to deduplicate and avoid double counting.
cards.action: Create an event ID variable using the community template gallery (the one by m barsh) and use it to deduplicate matching browser and server events.
applies_when: The same Meta event fires from browser pixel and server-side Conversions API
Contact form submits or page views are tracked in both places
You need to avoid double counting
do_not_use_when: Events are not sent from both browser and server
No matching browser and server events exist
unknowns: The exact event ID template and implementation are not fully shown
How the event ID is shared between client and server containers is not demonstrated
The passage is cut off before completing the event ID setup

we need to make sure that these events are duplicated to make sure that we're not double counting every event on our site and we're doing that through an event ID
